events.name: Robyn Hitchcock - Ages 18+
Black Stone Cherry Bonfire Nights: An Acoustic Evening
events.info: Black Stone Cherry are a band in the truest sense. Nearly twenty years after their explosive self-titled debut, the Kentucky foursome still bring the fire, friendship and collective spirit that first brought them together. Across eight albums, they've earned six UK Top 20 releases, four Top 25 US radio singles over their past two albums and a devoted worldwide following. Their sound draws on hard rock, metal, roots, blues, soul and hip hop, always anchored by songs with heart. That spirit drives Celebrate, a new EP produced by the band and recorded at High Street Studios in Bowling Green, Kentucky. Its six original songs and a cover of Simple Minds' , "rdquo" -> Don't You (Forget About Me)" capture four musicians making music together at the height of their powers. The record moves between muscular riffs, carefree energy and raw emotion, reflecting the lives they've shared onstage and off. The songs began taking shape on the road, where riffs and lyrics surfaced during soundchecks and tour bus rides. In early 2025, the band met twice a week at guitarist Ben Wells' home studio to develop them. Ideas passed freely among singer and guitarist Chris Robertson, Wells, drummer John Fred Young and bassist Steve Jewell. They swapped instruments, followed each other's instincts and built songs as a unit. The title track turns a heavyweight riff into an anthem about recognizing small, everyday victories, especially during difficult times. , "rdquo" -> Neon Eyes" grew from a soundcheck riff into a hard rock party starter, while , "rdquo" -> I'm Fine" brings a hazy grunge edge. , "rdquo" -> Up Down" adds a playful swagger and nods to early 2000s hip hop. At the EP's emotional center is , "rdquo" -> Deep." Wells began writing it two days after he and his wife experienced a miscarriage following years of fertility struggles. The song became a way to express feelings he had struggled to put into words. Its vulnerability also resonated with Jewell as his father, a musician and lifelong inspiration, faced a stage four cancer diagnosis. Black Stone Cherry have long found ways to turn painful experiences into music that connects and offers hope. Celebrate closes with the band's take on , "rdquo" -> Don't You (Forget About Me)," featuring longtime friend Tyler Connolly of Theory Of A Deadman. Robertson had wanted to cover the song for years, and the result pairs its familiar melody with Black Stone Cherry's grit and soul. The EP was mixed by Robertson with longtime engineer Jordan Westfall and assistant Mark Owens. It sounds both familiar and fresh: fierce enough for fans who have followed the band from the beginning, yet open to the new ideas that keep four old friends excited to make music together. That same commitment carries into their live shows. Whether playing to thousands at a festival or a packed 100-capacity pub, Black Stone Cherry give the crowd everything they have. On Celebrate, their priorities are unmistakable: loved ones, friendship, connection and songs that make people feel something. As Robertson puts it, the record is , "rdquo" -> an unpolished diamond."

Hours may vary for some events. The Central Ticket Office is located at Legacy Arena, Entry A 1898 9th Ave North, Birmingham, AL 35203.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call is located at the Central Ticket Office at Legacy Arena, Entry A 1898 9th Ave North, Birmingham, AL 35203. For most events, will call opens two hours before the scheduled start time. Hours may vary for some events. Please bring a picture ID, the actual credit card used to purchase the tickets, and your order number.

venues.parkingDetail: Visit www.BJCC.org/plan-your-visit/directions-and-parking for a printable map and to pre-purchase parking. Parking prices vary by event and date. We aim to make navigating the BJCC campus simple using clear directions. With various parking options for events, conventions, and meetings, planning ahead ensures a smoother arrival. Since multiple events often occur simultaneously, arrive early to avoid long parking and entry lines.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available throughout the venue and can be purchased on Ticketmaster.com. Guests requiring accessible seating are guaranteed the ability to purchase at least one (1) companion seat. Subject to availability, guests requiring wheelchair seating may purchase up to a total of three (3) companion seats in the same row and contiguous with the wheelchair seat. If contiguous seats have already been sold, seats as close as possible to the wheelchair seat and adjacent companion seat will be offered. If you purchased a ticket in the fixed seating area but require an accessible seat, the Ticket Office may be able to assist you by relocating your ticket to an accessible seat. Please contact the Ticket Office at CTO@bjcc.org if you have any questions or require assistance purchasing tickets. Tickets are subject to availability.

generalInfo.generalRule: Prohibited items include, but are not limited to laser pointers, weapons, glass containers, cans, chains, outside food or beverage, professional recording devices for photography, video or audio. See a full list of prohibited items at https://www.bjcc.org/plan-your-visit/bag-policy/ Bags must be CLEAR plastic, vinyl or PVC and not exceed 12"x6"x12". Bags cannot be tinted with color or include oversized content that prevents visibility into the clear bag. Only non-clear bags smaller than 5"x7" will be permitted entry. The arena reserves the right to search all guests entering the arena and to refuse entry at the discretion of management. Smoking is prohibited inside Legacy Arena and only allowed in designated smoking areas outside of the building.
generalInfo.childRule: For most events, children who have celebrated their 2nd birthday are required to have a ticket. For show specific age restrictions that may supersede our standard policy, visit www.bjcc.org/events

venues.name: Alabama Theatre

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Alabama Theatre does not have a full-time box office. The on-site box office opens 90 minutes before showtime for most events, and 1 hour before showtime for movies. Advance tickets may be purchased at Ticketmaster.com.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is only available beginning 90 minutes before that show. Will Call tickets may not be picked up at another event or when the box office is not open.

venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: This is an accessible venue. Accessible entrance is located on 3rd Avenue North. The Floor level (1st level) is accessible and does not require any stairs for access. Wheelchair spaces are marked on the Floor level.

generalInfo.generalRule: No weapons of any kind are allowed in the Alabama Theatre. All guests will be scanned with a metal detector wand and bags will be checked before entry to the building. No outside food or drink is allowed.
generalInfo.childRule: Children ages 2 and under do not need a ticket for most shows. This policy may vary for events designed for children. Please check the event listing for more specific information.
